components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button — Deep Petrol Ink fill, glows on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; gap: 0.375rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: oklch(0.755 0.085 196); color: oklch(0.21 0.03 200); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; transition: background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.755 0.085 196 / 80%); box-shadow: 0 0 20px -2px oklch(0.755 0.085 196); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.07 196 / 50%); border-color: oklch(0.62 0.07 196); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent with a hairline border, muted fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; gap: 0.375rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.945 0.005 210); border: 1px solid oklch(0.98 0.01 210 / 16%); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.275 0.013 222 / 50%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.07 196 / 50%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Transparent field, mono variant used for numeric goal entry.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2rem; width: 100%; min-width: 0; border-radius: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.98 0.01 210 / 16%); background: transparent; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; color: oklch(0.945 0.005 210); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.705 0.012 215); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.62 0.07 196); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.07 196 / 50%); } .ds-input.ds-input-mono { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Translucent container over the aurora background; the system's default surface.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; border-radius: 0.875rem; padding: 1rem; background: oklch(0.32 0.02 225 / 55%); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.945 0.005 210 / 10%); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Newsreader', ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.375; color: oklch(0.945 0.005 210); } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.705 0.012 215); }

components.name: Category Badge
components.description: A category color dot plus its name in muted text — the only place a category's chosen color surfaces as a swatch.
components.css: .ds-cat-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.705 0.012 215); } .ds-cat-dot { width: 0.375rem; height: 0.375rem; border-radius: 9999px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Completion Checkbox
components.description: Boolean goal check-in control; pops and turns Warm Gold on completion (see Signature Component: Completion Feedback).
components.css: .ds-checkbox { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.98 0.01 210 / 16%); transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-checkbox-checked { background: oklch(0.75 0.13 85); border-color: oklch(0.75 0.13 85); color: oklch(0.28 0.06 85); box-shadow: 0 0 10px -1px oklch(0.75 0.13 85); animation: ds-pop 320ms ease-out; } @keyframes ds-pop { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 45% { transform: scale(1.18); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }

components.name: Heatmap Cell Grid
components.description: GitHub-contribution-style weekly grid; success/missed/empty use the accent palette, never red/green.
components.css: .ds-heatmap { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-cell { width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-cell-done { background: oklch(0.755 0.085 196); } .ds-cell-missed { background: oklch(0.665 0.16 25 / 20%); } .ds-cell-empty { background: oklch(0.275 0.013 222); }

narrative.overview:
Ritual reads like a handwritten ledger, not a dashboard. Its two typefaces do the framing: Newsreader, a low-contrast reading serif, sets dates, section titles and the app's wordmark with a calm, editorial voice; IBM Plex Mono sets every number — streaks, dates, percentages, quantities — so figures line up and read as measured fact rather than decoration. Hanken Grotesk carries everything else at a quiet, humanist register. The result is closer to a bound notebook than a habit-tracking product: the interface disappears, the record of what was done does not.

Color follows the same discipline. Deep Petrol Ink is the system's only real accent — reserved for primary actions, focus rings, and progress — and it appears on a deliberately small share of any screen. Warm Gold is not a palette color at all; it is a single reserved signal for the one moment the product cares most about, a goal completed for the day. It never appears anywhere else. A slow-drifting Aurora Violet field lives only in the fixed background behind glass cards; it is atmosphere, never UI. Category colors, chosen per-goal by the user, are the only other color the interface shows.

The product currently ships dark-only: RootLayout hardcodes the dark class on html. A complete light palette exists in :root in globals.css and is visually coherent, but nothing in the UI currently lets a user reach it — a maintained but dormant second theme.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial serif for headings/titles, monospace for every number, humanist sans for body copy — three typefaces, each with exactly one job.
One accent (Deep Petrol Ink) used sparingly; one reserved signal color (Warm Gold) used for exactly one event.
Dark-only in practice today; a complete, unused light theme is maintained in the same tokens.
Flat surfaces with thin rings in the (dormant) light theme; translucent glass panels over a drifting aurora field in the shipped dark theme.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Warm Gold marks exactly one thing: a goal completed today. It is never reused for hover states, alerts, badges, or emphasis — its rarity is what makes it legible as a signal.

rules.name: The Category-Color Monopoly Rule
rules.body: Outside of Deep Petrol Ink (structural accent) and Warm Gold (completion signal), the only color a user sees is the category color they themselves chose per goal. The rest of the UI stays neutral so that color reads as real information.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any character that is a digit representing measured data (a date, a streak, a percentage, a quantity) renders in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums. Prose never borrows the mono face, and numbers never borrow the sans or serif face.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Structural hierarchy comes from surface color and translucency, not shadows. The only box-shadow usage in the system is an accent-colored glow on hover/success states.

dos: Do treat Warm Gold as a single reserved signal for "completed today" — never reuse it for hover, emphasis, or decoration.
Do keep Deep Petrol Ink as the only structural accent for actions, focus, and progress; let category colors (user-chosen, per goal) be the only other color on screen.
Do render every measured number — dates, streaks, percentages, quantities — in the mono typeface with tabular-nums.
Do use the aurora/glass treatment only for the dark theme; keep the light theme flat with ring borders, not shadows, if it's ever surfaced.
Do author new colors in OKLCH to match the project's canonical token format; don't introduce hex as a second source of truth.
donts: Don't use red/green traffic-light coloring for success/failure states (heatmap, streaks) — success is Deep Petrol Ink, failure is a quiet low-opacity destructive tint, not an alarm.
Don't add conventional drop shadows for card hierarchy — depth comes from translucency/blur (dark) or a thin ring (light), per the Flat-By-Default Rule.

Don't assume the light theme is reachable in the running app — it's a maintained second theme in the same token set, not the shipped default; verify before designing "for light mode" as if a toggle exists.
Don't add a second decorative accent hue beyond Deep Petrol Ink / Warm Gold / the background-only Aurora Violet without a stated reason — the palette's restraint is deliberate.
